versions.subject: Add registry_set_susp_pendingfilerenameoperations
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventType: 'SetValue'
    TargetObject|endswith: '\SYSTEM\ControlSet001\Control\SESSION MANAGER\PendingFileRenameOperations'
    Details|contains: 
        - '\AppData\'
        - '\Users\Public\'
        - '\Temp\'
condition: selection

versions.subject: Update registry_set_susp_pendingfilerenameoperations.yml

versions.subject: fix: update metadata
versions.detection:
selection_main:
    EventType: 'SetValue'
    TargetObject|contains: '\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\PendingFileRenameOperations'
selection_susp_paths:
    Image|contains:
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
        - '\Users\Public\'
selection_susp_images:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\reg.exe'
        - '\regedit.exe'
condition: selection_main and 1 of selection_susp_*
versions.spl: EventType="SetValue" TargetObject="*\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Session Manager\\PendingFileRenameOperations*" Image IN ("*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*", "*\\Users\\Public\\*") OR Image IN ("*\\reg.exe", "*\\regedit.exe")
